opening.argument: The studio setting and discussion of international affairs establish a news and commentary program, not an investment pitch. An anchor and guests discuss geopolitical developments, while the cryptocurrency segment presents investor participation as something the media reported and displays related allegations on an information board. Even the question “Do you buy our coin?” appears within a hypothetical analogy, not as a direction to viewers. The request to subscribe is ordinary audience engagement; nothing presented makes it a condition for payment, investment, data submission, or access to a financial benefit.
